title: Integer-translation equivariance for 2D periodic advection surrogates

parameters.translation_cells: integer dy, dx selected per evaluation case

transformation_preconditions: The scalar field is defined on a periodic Cartesian grid.
The advection step uses periodic boundary conditions.
The SUT inference path is deterministic for source and follow-up executions.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: Integer grid translation preserves the periodic boundary-value problem and the advection shift.

output_mapping.description: Roll the follow-up output by the inverse integer translation before comparing it with the source output.

exclusion_rules: Exclude nondeterministic runtime configurations from verdict generation.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The observed run satisfied the declared translation relation under the tolerance.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The observed run exceeded the declared translation tolerance and requires investigation.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because prerequisites were absent or disabled.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The source/follow-up pair did not satisfy the periodic translation preconditions.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: The result was dominated by numeric or determinism uncertainty.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The run did not provide enough evidence for pass/fail classification.

claim_limitations: This card defines an executable MR asset for the periodic-advection task. It does not itself report SUT pass/fail rates, real-defect detection, model accuracy, or general neural-operator reliability.
